title: Reading Blog Posts
text:
Many people read blog posts every day. A blog is a website where a person writes about things they like. Some blogs are about food, travel, or music. Writers often share photos and tips with their readers. Most blog posts are short and easy to read.

My friend Ana has a blog about cooking. She writes a new post every Sunday. Last week she shared a recipe for banana bread. Her readers write comments to say thank you. Ana says that she loves to talk with them.

options: A website where a person writes about things they like
A kind of book sold in shops

questions.text: How often does Ana write a new post?
How does Ana probably feel about her readers?
options: She feels happy and friendly toward them
She wants them to stop reading

questions.text: Why might someone read a travel blog?
options: To learn about places they could visit

vocabulary.definition: a place on the internet with pages of information
puts words on paper or a screen to make a text

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas leem posts de blog todos os dias. Um blog é um site onde uma pessoa escreve sobre coisas de que gosta. Alguns blogs são sobre comida, viagens ou música. Os escritores frequentemente compartilham fotos e dicas com os seus leitores. A maioria dos posts de blog é curta e fácil de ler.

Minha amiga Ana tem um blog sobre culinária. Ela escreve um novo post todo domingo. Na semana passada, ela compartilhou uma receita de pão de banana. Os seus leitores escrevem comentários para agradecer. Ana diz que adora conversar com eles.
